page: Microsoft Azure E8nds_v6 is an Endv6-family virtual machine configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs on an x86_64 Intel processor architecture. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance provides 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

The server features 472 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage. Classified as network-optimized within its family, the instance is designed to handle workloads requiring both local high-speed disk access and enhanced network throughput. It does not include any GPU accelerators.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated resource allocation and high memory density position this server for memory-intensive applications without the overhead of larger instance sizes. The combination of 64.0 GB of RAM, dedicated Intel vCPUs, and local NVMe storage makes this configuration suitable for database hosting, memory-cached applications, and network-heavy enterprise workloads.
